feature: Premium redesign + jewellery e-commerce + admin panel + founders page

commerceModel.detail: Build the complete cart and checkout experience. Real payment capture stays behind a feature flag until the client's Razorpay KYC clears. Until then the final step captures the order and tells the customer the shop will call to take payment.
implications: Order and line-item tables must snapshot price at order time (gold rate volatility).
Payment provider integration is designed for but not switched on; the flag must be a single, obvious toggle.
Nothing may claim a payment succeeded while the flag is off.

adminAuth.detail: Owner-set password, signed cookie session using WebCrypto. No dependency on the shop owner holding a ChatGPT or Google account.
implications: Password must be stored hashed, never in source or site-config.
Sessions must work on the Workers runtime with no Node built-ins.
SIWC (app/chatgpt-auth.ts) is NOT used for admin; the README warns it proves identity, not authorisation.

content.detail: Product photography and the two founder portraits are generated as placeholders so the site demos convincingly before real assets exist.
implications: Placeholder assets must be clearly marked as such in the repo and swappable in one place.
No fabricated factual claims (prices, weights, certifications, founder names/bios) presented as real.

sequencing.detail: Milestone 1: premium visual direction + founders page, delivered for review. Milestone 2: storefront. Milestone 3: admin panel.
implications: Design direction is approved before ~20 commerce screens are built on top of it.
Storefront and admin inherit the approved design system rather than defining their own.

brandBrief: Rich Indian heritage craft, run by modern people. Must read as neither a dusty traditional gold-shop site nor a generic minimal DTC startup.
openQuestions: Real phone / WhatsApp / address (SITE_DETAILS_PENDING still true)
Founder and co-founder real names, bios and photos
Whether the client has an existing Razorpay account or needs onboarding
Real catalogue: pieces, weights, purity, making charges, pricing
